title: Mom of student killed in Iran protests searched through hundreds of bodies to find her
summary: Rubina Aminian was a "full of life" 23-year-old Iranian fashion student with big goals for the future. She was shot and killed last week amid the protests, her aunt told CBS News, as she described how Aminian's mother forced her way into a morgue and carried her daughter's body out. Imtiaz Tyab has details.
